origins.name: Boeotia (Plataea & Thebes)
origins.description: The sacred borderlands of Cithaeron and the birthplace of the Cadmeia. Heart of heroic shepherd traditions.
origins.perks: +1 Wisdom • +1 Survival • High standing with Plataeans

origins.name: Attica (Athens)
origins.description: The olive-bearing plains beneath the Parthenon. Renowned for sharp rhetoric, tactical philosophy, and civil law.

origins.name: Laconia (Sparta)
origins.description: The Eurotas valley, where youths endure the uncompromising martial discipline of Lycurgus.

origins.name: Arcadia (Highlands)
origins.description: The ancient pine forests and crags where Pan and Hermes roam among mortal herdsmen.
